r: I killed most of the trolls in the cave.

caeda_1.m: So much work to do. I sure hope we will have some rain soon.

caeda_10.m: Oh, it is you again. Did you find my key?

caeda_2.m: So much work to do. I sure hope we will have some rain soon.
r: Do you know where I can find some damerilias?

caeda_20.m: Oh, it is you. Nice to meet you again.

caeda_30.m: Oh, it is you again. Did you find my key?
r: Yes. Eh, no. I seem to have lost it. Wait, I'll go and find it.

caeda_40.m: Oh, it is you again. Thank you again for bringing back my key.

caeda_60.m: Oh, it is you again. Thank you for all you have done.
r: Could you give me the key for the glade again?
It was all for the Shadow.

caeda_root10_1.m: Yes I happen to have some. Why are you asking?
r: There is this woman in Stoutford, she wants some for the grave of her husband, Noraed.

caeda_root10_2.m: Noraed is dead? Oh no ... my poor little brother. What happened?
r: He was killed saving the life of his wife, during a monster attack on Stoutford.

caeda_root10_3.m: Yes, that would be him. He loved Aryfora so much. I never had the chance to meet her.

caeda_root10_3a.m: Every year he came to pick the most beautiful damerilia to give it to her as a present.
r: Yes, Aryfora told me. She asked me to bring her some damerilias for Noraed's grave.

caeda_root10_4.m: I still have some. Here, take these to her, and send her my condolences.
r: Thanks. I'll make sure she gets them.
All this trouble for a bunch of smelly flowers...

caeda_root10_5.m: These damerilias are not really good any more. You should get fresh ones from my family's glade north of Remgard.
r: How would I get to your glade?

caeda_root10_6.m: To find the glade you have to pass through a cave. There are trolls, but my father had put up a statue that the trolls don't like to pass. So I was able to pass through the cave fairly safely.

caeda_root10_6a.m: The glade itself is barred by a solid door to keep the trolls out. I had a key for it of course.

caeda_root10_7.m: Yes. Unfortunately I did not pay enough attention to where I was going when I was there last time, and took a wrong turn.

caeda_root10_8.m: Suddenly there were trolls everywhere. I barely escaped, but I must have lost the key to our glade there. If only I could have my key back!
r: Your damerilias do look a bit wilted. I will go to your glade.
Eh, OK. This isn't worth the trouble. Fresh damerilias wouldn't look different after my travel back. Thank you, I will return to Stoutford directly.

caeda_root10_8a.m: Farewell then. Give my greetings to my sister-in-law.

caeda_root10_9.m: And you will bring back my key to the glade? Then I would be the happiest person!

caeda_root30_1.m: You really found my key! Thank you - I can't believe it!
r: A troll had taken the key, but he won't need it any more.

caeda_root40_1.m: With all these trolls around I don't feel safe to go through the cave and take care of the flowers in the glade.

caeda_root40_1a.m: The scorpions are bad enough, but the trolls are really dangerous. I know that they hate the statue, but I am scared they can reach past it.

caeda_root40_2.m: Would it be too much to ask if you could get rid of the trolls?
r: I can teach them to stay further away from the statue. No problem.

caeda_root50_2.m: Is the passage to the glade safe again?
r: No, not yet. I guess there are at least 30 trolls to kill. I will go after them again.

caeda_root50_2a.m: Please do, and come to me when you are done with them.

caeda_root50_3.m: Is the passage to the glade safe again?
r: Yes, I have dealt with most of the trolls. They won't dare to bother you for a long time.

caeda_root50_4.m: Thank you so much! I wish you safe travels back to Stoutford. If you want to go to the glade next time you are in Remgard, just ask me for the key.
r: Thank you. I will leave now.

caeda_root60_1.m: Yes, of course. I will give you my father's key. Keep it. Then you can always pick damerilias for Noraed's grave.
r: That would be great, thank you.

caeda_root60_2.m: Here is the key. I will move to the glade and retire there. It is the most beautiful place in the world.
r: So I will meet you there. Bye.

roots_love.10: Aryfora, a woman grieving in Stoutford's graveyard asked me to bring her some damerilias from Remgard for the grave of Noraed, her husband.
roots_love.20: Noraed's sister, Caeda, gave me some damerilias. I should bring them back to Stoutford.
roots_love.30: I have brought the damerilias back to Aryfora. She thanked me with a potion she made.
roots_love.40: I told her the flowers were from Noraed's sister, Caeda.
roots_love.45: I told her I found the flowers around Remgard, in the wild.

secret_garden.10:
Caeda in Remgard told me I can find fresh damerilias in her family's glade, but the key was taken by monsters.
If I can find the key in the cave north of Remgard, I can access that glade, but I have to return the key to Caeda.
secret_garden.20: Finding the key was not worth the trouble. The wilted damerilias Caeda gave me will be just fine.
secret_garden.30: I killed some monsters and found the key to the glade.
secret_garden.40: I returned the key right away to Caeda.
secret_garden.45: I kept the key for a while, but finally returned it to Caeda.
secret_garden.50: Caeda asked for my help to clear out the monsters in the caves so that she can go back there and attend to the flowers.
secret_garden.55: Many monsters are dead now. The rest will no longer dare to approach the statue.
secret_garden.60: I told Caeda, so that she can attend to the glade.
